Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Transitional Tufted Dot Diamond Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17" , Navy
Colors: Navy
Raised, tufted dots accent a printed geometric pattern for a three-dimensional look and texture. For an instant style change, flip it over to show off the navy linen-look back. This pillow provides a quick, eye-catching update to any style room. 17" x 17" Front: 100% cotton with polyester embroidered thread; back: 100% polyester Removable polyester fiber-filled insert included Insert can be easily removed via the bottom zipper Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry.
